sql: SELECT split_part(market_ticker, '-', 1) AS series, count(*) FILTER (WHERE at < '2026-10-08') AS snaps_pre_1008, count(*) FILTER (WHERE at >= '2026-10-30') AS snaps_post_1030, min(at)::date AS first_seen FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE at >= '2026-09-17' AND split_part(market_ticker, '-', 1) IN ('KXASPENMTNOPEN','KXAAAGASM','KXBIGSKYOPEN','KXFLVISITORCOUNT','KXWALLSTBONUS','KXNYCASKRENT','KXTXINCOMETAX','KXNYSECEEMP','KXPJMEMERGENCY','KXISRUNITY','KXNJPHARMAEMP','KXILNUCLEAR','KXPAMFGEMP','KXBAA','KXTXERCOTPEAK','KXWATECHEMP','KXWAAEROEMP','KXCABUILDPERMITS','KXNYNJPORTTEU','KXTXOIL') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
